blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 447140870, the replacement USDv mint is owned by Token-2022 and retains freeze authority 5iMSLkZdvmYZUb3LPbmvynAujEuyyu7azLeQpRSfjY1p. The separately read Chancery configuration binds this authority to the replacement mint. Published freeze_issued_token_account code permits governance, operations, emergency, enforcement or a narrowly authorized permission holder to freeze an individual USDv token account through the authority PDA. This control is distinct from legacy USDv, whose disabled freeze authority is not inherited. Permanent-delegate and pausable extensions are present, but this verdict does not assume a currently executable forced-seizure path merely from those extensions.

oracleRisk.summary: Chancery direct issuance and redemption use configured deposit_rate_e9 and redeem_rate_e9 values. Privileged asset-configuration updates can change these rates subject to program controls. These are internal settlement-price authorities, not independent market-price oracles or borrower liquidation feeds.

branchApplicability.rationale: The replacement mint settles approved counterparties against configured reserve assets at administrator-configured rates. Its reviewed path has no borrower-owned collateral positions or oracle-triggered liquidation branches. Internal settlement rates remain a price-sensitive control even when configured at par.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: The reviewed replacement USDv is a native Solana Token-2022 mint controlled by Chancery.
